correctness.rationale: Unrolling e_{k+1}=(I−αH)e_k−αξ gives deterministic mean P(H)e0 independent of order and terminal covariance Σ_k α_k² T_k Q T_k. Neighboring α,β have identical earlier/later contributions because all updates commute; exact expansion produces covariance difference αβ(β−α)T(HQ+QH)T. Since spectral W,H,T commute, trace difference =2αβ(β−α)tr(WHT²Q), a nonnegative PSD-product trace multiplied by the swap sign. Adjacent inversion removal sorts all steps, proving simultaneous terminal-risk minimization with no stable-step restriction; strictness follows if Q,W≻0 and suffix T≠0. A complete distinct reciprocal-eigenvalue step set leaves a nonannihilated eigenspace in any inversion suffix. Loewner fails for H=diag(1,9) and Q=[[1,.8],[.8,1]], whose HQ+QH determinant −28; isotropic Q gives Loewner. Independent simulation generated 75 random SPD H,Q pairs of dimensions 2–4 and all 24 step permutations each, and verified all terminal risk inequalities and precise adjacent exchange matrices. The proof is algebraic, not from simulation.
